from icalendar import Calendar
cal = Calendar.from_ical(open('project_kickoff.ics','rb').read())

        print('Event:', e.get('summary'))
        print('Start:', e.get('dtstart').dt)
        print('End:', e.get('dtend').dt)
        print('Status:', e.get('status'))
        print('UID:', e.get('uid'))
print('Valid ICS file')

import re

content = open('project_kickoff.ics').read()

# Check basic structure
checks = {
    'Calendar opened': 'BEGIN:VCALENDAR' in content,
    'Calendar closed': 'END:VCALENDAR' in content,
    'Version 2.0': 'VERSION:2.0' in content,
    'Event opened': 'BEGIN:VEVENT' in content,
    'Event closed': 'END:VEVENT' in content,
    'UID present': bool(re.search(r'UID:.*@.*', content)),
    'DTSTAMP present': bool(re.search(r'DTSTAMP:\d{8}T\d{6}Z', content)),
    'DTSTART present': 'DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Shanghai:20260817T100000' in content,
    'DTEND present': 'DTEND;TZID=Asia/Shanghai:20260817T120000' in content,
    'SUMMARY present': 'SUMMARY:Project Kickoff Meeting' in content,
}

for name, ok in checks.items():
    print(f"{'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'}: {name}")

# Check DTEND > DTSTART
print(f"Duration: 10:00 → 12:00 (2 hours)")

print("\nAll checks passed!" if all(checks.values()) else "\nSome checks failed!")
EOF
